scenes.spoken: मीरा के पास तेईस नावें थीं।
scenes.roman: Meera ke paas teis naavein thi.
scenes.action: Open on red paper hull. Pull back to all 23 boats behind glass.

scenes.spoken: उनमें से एक ने भी कभी पानी नहीं छुआ था।
scenes.roman: Ek ne bhi kabhi paani nahi chhua tha.
scenes.action: A drop tracks down the glass in front of the completely dry red boat.

scenes.spoken: जब भी मीरा नाव बनाती, पापा उसे अलमारी में रख देते।
scenes.roman: Jab bhi Meera naav banati, Papa use almaari mein rakh dete.
scenes.purpose: Give the father a concrete habit.
scenes.action: Papa raises a paper boat toward the shelf as Meera watches.

scenes.spoken: कहते, भीग गई तो खराब हो जाएगी।
scenes.roman: Kehte, “Bheeg gayi toh kharaab ho jaayegi.”
scenes.action: Papa glances from the boat to Meera, palm turned up.

scenes.spoken: फिर एक दिन इतनी बारिश हुई कि गली में छोटी सी नदी बन गई।
scenes.roman: Phir ek din itni baarish hui ki gali mein chhoti si nadi ban gayi.
scenes.action: Rain darkens the lane. Water ripples beneath a little arched bridge.

scenes.spoken: मीरा ने पूछा, पापा, इनमें सबसे तेज़ कौन सी है?
scenes.roman: Meera ne poochha, “Papa, inmein sabse tez kaun si hai?”
scenes.purpose: Make the child ask the question the collection cannot answer.
scenes.action: She looks up and holds out an empty palm.

scenes.spoken: पापा ने तेईसों नावें देखीं। जवाब एक भी नहीं था।
scenes.roman: Papa ne teison naavein dekhin. Jawaab ek bhi nahi tha.
scenes.purpose: Hold on the cost of keeping everything safe.
scenes.action: His eyes move from the cabinet to the rain.

scenes.spoken: उन्होंने लाल वाली उठाई। आज पता करते हैं।
scenes.roman: Unhone laal waali uthaai. “Aaj pata karte hain.”
scenes.purpose: Pay the first question forward with a choice.
scenes.action: Father offers Meera the red boat.

scenes.spoken: मीरा ने उसे पानी पर रखा। दो पल तो वो खूब चली।
scenes.roman: Meera ne use paani par rakha. Do pal toh woh khoob chali.
scenes.purpose: Let the audience root for the first launch.
scenes.action: A hand lowers the red boat. It leaves concentric ripples.

scenes.spoken: फिर एक पत्ता अटका। नाव एक तरफ झुक गई।
scenes.roman: Phir ek patta atka. Naav ek taraf jhuk gayi.
scenes.action: A gold leaf snags at the bow and tips the hull.

scenes.spoken: पापा का हाथ बढ़ा। मीरा बोली, एक मिनट।
scenes.roman: Papa ka haath badha. Meera boli, “Ek minute.”
scenes.purpose: Repeat the protective gesture and interrupt it.
scenes.action: A large hand reaches in and pauses over the listing boat.

scenes.spoken: उसने गीला कोना ऊपर मोड़ा। पत्ता छूटा।
scenes.roman: Usne geela kona oopar moda. Patta chhoota.
scenes.action: Small fingers lift the folded bow. The leaf peels away.

scenes.spoken: इस बार नाव सीधे पुल के नीचे से निकल गई।
scenes.roman: Is baar naav seedhe pul ke neeche se nikal gayi.
scenes.purpose: Answer the practical question with action.
scenes.action: Track the red boat as it passes through the low bridge.

scenes.spoken: अगली सुबह, लाल नाव की जगह एक फोटो लगी थी।
scenes.roman: Agli subah, laal naav ki jagah ek photo lagi thi.
scenes.purpose: Return to the opening cabinet and change one detail.
scenes.action: A matted photo stands in the gap left by the red boat.

scenes.spoken: पीछे पापा की लिखावट थी। आज मेरी बेटी ने मुझे नाव चलाना सिखाया।
scenes.roman: Peechhe Papa ki likhaavat thi. “Aaj meri beti ne mujhe naav chalaana sikhaaya.”
scenes.purpose: The parent has learned something too.
scenes.action: Turn the photo over to reveal the note and a tiny drawing of a boat.
